title: Builder Extended Rate Lock — Early Extension Request Credit
content:
A buyer who extends a Builder Extended Rate Lock well before it would expire receives a credit against the extension fee percent.

**Rule.** The extension lead is the calendar days from the extension date to the lock expiration date as it stood before the extension. A lead above 20 days takes 0.0625 percentage points off the extension fee percent; a lead of 8 days up to 20 days takes 0.03125 percentage points off; a shorter lead takes nothing off. The points are taken off the extension fee percent before it is applied to the loan amount on the lock.

| Extension lead | Taken off the extension fee percent |
|---|---|
| 0 to 7 days | nothing |
| 8 to 20 days | 0.03125 percentage points |
| 21 days or more | 0.0625 percentage points |

## Boundary cases (hypothetical dates, expiration date before the extension 31 July)

| Extension date | Lead | Credit |
|---|---|---|
| 24 July | 7 | nothing |
| 23 July | 8 | 0.03125 |
| 11 July | 20 | 0.03125 |
| 10 July | 21 | 0.0625 |

The lead is measured to the expiration date that stood before the extension moved it, not to the new expiration date.
